fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects port forwarding activity via SSH.exe
fields.name: Port Forwarding Activity Via SSH.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\ssh.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -R " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " /R " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " –R " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " —R " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " ―R ")))
